configure_global_pool: configure the global Lean REPL pool with a workspace path and pool size
get_global_pool: get or lazily create the global Lean REPL pool for code checking
check_code: check a Lean 4 code snippet for compilation errors using the global REPL pool
shutdown_global_pool: shutdown the global Lean REPL pool and release all resources
LeanToolsMixin: register the lean_check tool on an agent to verify Lean 4 code snippets
